actual_task_instruction: I am going for a 15-minute drive without internet. Play an album from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.

packet_source.instruction: I am going for a 15-minute drive without internet. Play an album from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.

agents.actual_task_instruction: I am going for a 15-minute drive without internet. Play an album from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.
released_registered_requirements:
obtain added, updated, removed spotify.MusicPlayer records using models.changed_records,
and assert 0 have been added or removed.

assert all song_ids in private_data.downloaded_song_ids are in
queue_song_ids from music player in the end state.

assert no song_id outside of private_data.collection_song_ids are in
queue_song_ids from music player in the end state.
